top1.title: 【2026-10-29】Google、Geminiと検索に外部アプリを接続する開発者向け基盤を公開
top1.lead1: GoogleがConnected Apps Platformを米国開発者向けにプレビュー公開した。
top1.lead2: 外部サービスをGeminiや検索から利用する仕組みを拡大。開発者は接続アプリの登録やテスト、稼働状況の確認ができる。

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Google unveils developer platform for connecting external apps to Gemini and Search
top10.summary: Google released a preview of Connected Apps Platform for U.S. developers. It connects external services to Gemini and Search, allowing developers to register and test them and monitor usage.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Nvidia announces open-weight model supporting transcription in 40 languages
top10.summary: Nvidia released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and a new version of the Granary audio dataset. The model supports recordings up to one hour long and identification of up to eight speakers, but does not support live audio.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Anthropic announces reporting features to visualize the impact and costs of enterprise AI use
top10.summary: Based on internal analytics and employee surveys, the features visualize team outcomes, costs and workflow issues. They also provide improvement suggestions and management of shared team token budgets.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Meta signals another delay to new business terms amid concerns over AI training
top10.summary: Regarding new terms that have prompted publishers' concerns about use of their content for AI training, Meta said it would postpone implementation until November 20 or later if discussions drag on. The current terms will remain in place.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Chrome uses AI to fill forms with booking references and shipping information from Gmail
top10.summary: Autofill powered by Gemini's Personal Intelligence is rolling out in the U.S. It suggests booking references, tracking numbers and other information from Gmail, and users can disable it in settings.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Xreal launches Aura glasses running Android XR with access to Gemini
top10.summary: Xreal announced wired glasses that connect to an external processing device. Gemini helps interpret on-screen context. Orders have opened in four countries, including Japan, with shipping scheduled to begin by mid-November.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] Microsoft to end support for Copilot on smart TVs
top10.summary: Reports say an on-screen notice on LG TVs revealed plans to discontinue Copilot for TVs during 2026. No specific shutdown date has been given.

top10.title: [2026-10-29] [Commentary] TechCrunch highlights gap between AI executives' outlook on life and ordinary users' perspectives
top10.summary: The commentary examines executives' remarks about entrusting parenting and personal relationships to AI. It discusses how developers' emphasis on efficiency may diverge from users' expectations.

editorsDesk.recTitle: 米国政府、AnthropicにFable 5/Mythos 5の海外アクセス停止命令
editorsDesk.recNote: 輸出規制によりFable 5とMythos 5の全世界・外国アクセスが停止。AI地政学の新局面を象徴する事態。
